analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. 5일 저가 대비 20일 저가가 높아지며 회복 신호는 나타나고 있으나, SMA20(86,878원) 저항 및 거래량 위축(0.52배)으로 상승 동력 부족. 82,500원 지지선 하향 이탈 시 매도 고려.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. A higher low pattern is emerging (5-day low vs 20-day low), but insufficient upward momentum due to SMA20 resistance at 86,878 KRW and subdued volume (0.52x). Consider selling on a break below the 82,500 KRW support.

· 스윙 저항선 (89,550원): 돌파 시 중기 추세 전환 가능성 열림

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (82,980 KRW) above SMA5 (82,248 KRW), below SMA20 (86,878 KRW) and SMA50 (98,207 KRW): diagnosing short-term weak, mid-term weak trend.
· Significantly below SMA100 (105,585 KRW) and SMA200 (100,925 KRW): confirming strong mid-to-long term downtrend.
· 52-week position (29.4%): attempting a rebound from near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.3→39.1): exiting oversold, now consolidating in neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-346.1710→87.3599): improving from negative territory, no confirmed downtrend reversal signal yet.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 86,878 KRW): consolidating near the mid-band, bandwidth (20.52%) at a moderate level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (82,500 KRW): positioned above Pivot S1 (73,565 KRW), acting as short-term support.
· Swing resistance (89,550 KRW): a break above could open possibilities for a mid-term trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal, potential early stage of trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.52x): contracted compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): consider entering long after confirmation of 82,500 KRW support, or on a break above the 89,550 KRW resistance.
